s.note: Grilled Italian bread rubbed with garlic, topped with tomato and basil.
s.how: Slice an Italian loaf into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or chargrill until charred. Rub each piece with a cut garlic clove. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes, mix with torn basil, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, a splash of balsamic and sea salt, and rest 10 minutes. Pile on the bread just before serving and top with shaved parmesan.

s.note: Clam strips soaked in buttermilk, fried crisp in a cornmeal crust, tartare and lemon.
s.how: Clam meat or calamari soaked in buttermilk, dredged in cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, with tartare and lemon. Cut 500g clam meat or calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk for 15 minutes. Dredge in 100g fine cornmeal mixed with 50g plain flour and fry in batches at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

m.n: I pity the fool rematch chicken
m.note: Grilled lemon oregano chicken thighs with brown rice and broccoli.
m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.

w.note: Crisp shells piped with sweet ricotta and orange, the ends dipped in dark chocolate.
w.how: Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar and orange zest, piped into crisp bought shells just before serving, the ends dipped in dark chocolate. Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Melt 50g dark chocolate and dip the ends of 8 cannoli shells, then let set. Pipe the filling in just before serving.

d.note: Fresh lemonade with mint over lots of ice.
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in with plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into tall glasses.
